events.title: Mentors Usergroup Removed
events.description: Omniscient disbanded the Mentors official user group after the group's promised participation and help on the forum failed to materialize.

events.title: MRT-X Usergroup Removed
events.description: Omniscient removed the MRT-X official user group following the absence of leader Tha Sneak, who had been MIA for over two months.

events.title: New Jailbreaking, Modding, and Rooting Forum
events.description: Omniscient launched a new subforum dedicated to Jailbreaking, Modding, and Rooting to better accommodate the growing discussions around these topics.

events.title: Group & Crew News
events.description: Succubus and Olympians groups remain listed for sale. MRT-X and Mentors groups deleted. Slots night announced ($100 buy-in, prize pool split among participants, with entry into Gamblers). NERO was added as a leader to Fallen.
